turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hello, Sea View Hotel. How can I help?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi. I have a booking for next Tuesday and Wednesday, under the name Sam. Could I possibly change the dates? My work trip has moved one day later.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. So you'd like Wednesday and Thursday instead?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, that's right. And I need a desk, because I'll be working in my room.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Your room is free on Wednesday, but not on Thursday. On Thursday I have a smaller room for sixty dollars, but it doesn't have a desk.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you, but I really need a desk. Without one, I can't work. Is there another room with a desk?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: There's a larger room with a desk for ninety dollars, so twenty more.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: It's only for one night, so that's fine. I'll take the larger room on Thursday.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Okay. Your room on Wednesday for seventy, and the larger room on Thursday for ninety.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. And there's no charge for changing the dates, right?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: No charge at all. See you on Wednesday!
